purpose: E3 step 1 (GROW_UP_ROOT_DOWN_REVISE_20261113 §5.4 K3): registered offline feasibility test of the K3 VLM locate primitive before it may enter K_v2. 2D answers only; no physics, no task episodes, no evaluator change.
frames: The 320x180 head frame locate read in every ready engineering episode of the checkpointed stage-0 rerun (21 frames, recovered from each 00_configured checkpoint), plus a 640x360 render of the same camera at the same state.

groups.hard: locate failed in the run and the target prototype is listed in hard_prototypes (stage 0: apple 0/3, blue slim tumbler 0/3)
groups.rule_ok: locate passed its boundary check in the run (control)
groups.rule_failed_other: any other locate failure (stage 0: one white standard mug, cylinder fit)

query: harness/vlm_locate.query_text: 'the <nearest public colour word of appearance_rgba> <category>' from the public task's target role
size_note: 320x180 is the kernel head camera and the only size the decision uses. 640x360 is a sensor change: reported, and used only if the user decides so.
budget_note: 21 frames x 2 sizes x 2 repeats = 84 local model calls; no physics episodes.

baselines.colour: nominal_rgba colour variant (tabletop.colour_baseline): largest component passing the platter rule's colour test; no confidence, so every wrong answer counts as a high-confidence error for this arm
baselines.original_rule: the run's own locate outcome, which defines the groups

metrics: per arm, size and group: n, 2D hits (answered point on a target-mask pixel), abstentions, invalid replies, high-confidence errors (wrong answer at confidence >= 0.7), median latency, repeat agreement (VLM)
prediction: VLM at 320x180: at least 4/6 hits on hard frames and at least 12/14 hits on rule_ok frames.

The colour baseline hits the apples (3/3 expected) but can lock onto a same-coloured container for the blue tumblers (the TP03_near_1130307 tray is blue and the baseline's largest component there is the tray): 3-5/6 expected. This prediction was informed by running colour_baseline on nine stage-0 initial_head.jpg images (no masks, so no hit scores) and viewing two of them before any VLM call.
Repeated calls at temperature 0 agree on at least 90% of frames.
falsification: Registered in the design doc: VLM hits on hard frames at 320x180 not above the colour baseline's, or any VLM high-confidence error on rule_ok frames at 320x180. Either one keeps K3 out of K_v2; the first series then uses K_v1 and the result is recorded.
Not tested here: relation queries (TP05/TP06), depth lifting and the geometric veto.
